title: JMAP endpoint has no HTTP body size limit; max_size_request advertised but unenforced
description: kithd/src/lib.rs build_app registers the axum Json extractor with no RequestBodyLimitLayer. The session advertises max_size_request=10MiB but the server never enforces it. Any tailnet peer can POST an arbitrarily large body to /jmap/api, causing full deserialization into serde_json::Value before any application code runs — trivial OOM. Fix: add tower_http::limit::RequestBodyLimitLayer::new(10*1024*1024) to the router in build_app.
